steps.instruction: Propose one bounded goal work item for implementing the complete standard-library-only csv_tool.py source. The proposal description must require parse_records, format_records, to_json, and CLI behavior exactly as specified; strict rejection of malformed quoting, wrong headers, wrong column counts, invalid record keys/types; LF serialization; useful error handling; and delivery of the complete source as a JSON-escaped artifact.inline_text. Use payload fields work_id, expected_goal_revision, kind, title, description, dependency_ids; set expected_goal_revision to 1, kind to goal, and dependency_ids to an empty list.

Propose one bounded goal work item for independently authoring a comprehensive behavioral test suite/specification for csv_tool.py without implementing the library. Cover valid CSV features, all required rejection cases, exact round trips, JSON preservation, stdout/stderr/exit-code CLI behavior, and likely Python csv-module strictness traps. Require delivery as concise complete test source in JSON-escaped artifact.inline_text that an integration owner can run against the implementation. Use payload fields work_id, expected_goal_revision, kind, title, description, dependency_ids; set expected_goal_revision to 1, kind to goal, and dependency_ids to an empty list.

Propose one bounded goal work item for an independent edge-case and design analysis of the requested CSV parser/formatter, focused on standard-library csv behavior, malformed quote detection beyond csv.reader defaults, newline/CRLF handling, exact header enforcement, record validation, JSON Unicode fidelity, and CLI failure hygiene. Require a concise integration-ready design/review checklist delivered as JSON-escaped artifact.inline_text, with no implementation overlap. Use payload fields work_id, expected_goal_revision, kind, title, description, dependency_ids; set expected_goal_revision to 1, kind to goal, and dependency_ids to an empty list.

decision.reason: Three non-overlapping contributions are useful: Agent A owns implementation, Agent B owns independent behavioral tests, and Agent C owns edge-case/design analysis. The judge remains unassigned and reserved for the required final independent review.
